data.name: Theomir
data.gender_notes: Theomir is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek words theos (god) and mir (warrior). This name is given to a child believed to be protected by God and destined to be a warrior for Him. The name Theomir carries the meaning “Divine warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek. Parents who choose Theomir usually hope their child will grow to embody divine warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to be a warrior for God.
data.etymology: Theomir belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Theomir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: תאומיר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: תאומיר הוא שם פרטי שמקורו בשפות שמיות ומורכב משני שורשים: תאו (אלוהים שלי) ומיר (אור). הוא משמש כביטוי של אמונה וקשר עם האלוהים, והוא נושא משמעות עמוקה של אור אלוהי.

in_greek.name: Θεομήρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Θεομήρ είναι ένα όνομα που συνδυάζει το Θεός (Θεός) και το μήρ (φως), εκφράζοντας την πίστη και τη σύνδεση με το θείο φως. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανικών ονομάτων, αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία του φωτός ως σύμβολο της αλήθειας και της σωτηρίας.

in_latin.name: Theomir
in_latin.long_meaning: Theomir, eximius et insignis nominis Christiani, significat 'Deus meus est lux'. Hoc nomen profundam devotionem et connexionem cum divino lumine exprimit, quod in traditione Christiana saluti et veritati adsignatur.

data.cultural_impact: The name Theomir carries a significant cultural impact as it originates from the Greek language. The grapevine of "Theo" has deep connections to Greek mythology, where gods and goddesses held immense importance. Naming a child Theomir would evoke strong images of divine protection, valor, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Theomir is steeped in spiritual significance, as it's derived from the Greek words for 'god' and 'warrior.' This namesake conveys a child's divine protection and a warrior's spirit. It is a reminder of the child's spiritual roots, connecting them to the power and strength of God. The name inspires a sense of courage, duty, and faithfulness, urging the child to walk a righteous path and embody the qualities of a spiritual warrior who stands strong in the face of challenges and adversity. In Christian traditions, it emphasizes the child's role as a representative of God in the world and encourages a life of service to Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Theomir derives from Greek origins, meaning "divine peace" or "miracle of God." It is a name that symbolizes the deep connection between an individual and their divine source, reflecting the belief that inner peace and spiritual growth come from the grace of God.

historical_references.reference: Theomir was a Slavic duke who ruled over the Duchy of Pannonia in the 10th century. He converted to Christianity under the influence of Saint Adalbert of Prague and was baptized in the Danube River. After his conversion, he took the Christian name Teodemar, which later evolved into Theomir.
historical_references.context: Early Christianization of Slavic peoples in Central Europe

historical_references.reference: Theomir is also mentioned in the chronicles of Cosmas of Prague as one of the earliest Christian rulers in Bohemia, around 970 AD. He was a vassal of Boleslaus I of Bohemia and was a patron of the early Christian churches in the region. His Christian name Theomir is derived from the Greek theos (god) and mir (mercy).
historical_references.context: Early Christianization of Bohemia and the development of the Bohemian state
